VR.title: Quest 3 Headsets Are Heading To The International Space Station
VR.summary: Two Quest 3 headsets are heading to the International Space Station to train astronauts for spacewalks in collaboration with the European Space Agency.

VR.title: This Quest Accessory Wants to Turn Your Brain Activity Into VR Avatar Control
VR.summary: PiEEG is launching a brain-computer interface accessory for Quest headsets, enabling real-time avatar control through brain signals and facial micro-expressions.

VR.title: KRVR Supports Apple Vision Pro's Foveated Streaming For SteamVR Games
VR.summary: KRVR app allows Apple Vision Pro users to play any SteamVR game with foveated streaming, enhancing the gaming experience on the new headset.

VR.title: James Cameron’s 3D Studio Acquires 3D Camera Maker STEREOTEC
VR.summary: James Cameron’s Lightstorm Vision has acquired 3D camera maker STEREOTEC, aiming to integrate its technology into future projects.

VR.title: Spatial Is Discontinuing Its Creator Platform In July
VR.summary: Spatial is discontinuing its creator platform to focus on original IP development, marking a significant shift in its business strategy.

VR.title: PlayStation VR2 Gets A Discount For Sony PlayStation Days Of Play
VR.summary: PlayStation VR2 is available at a $100 discount during Sony's Days of Play event, running from May 27 to June 10.

AI.title: Microsoft’s first advanced reasoning AI is here
AI.summary: Microsoft unveiled its first advanced reasoning AI model, MAI-Thinking-1, at Build 2026, marking a significant step in its AI development.

AI.title: Microsoft and OpenAI broke up — now they’re ready to fight
AI.summary: Microsoft announced new AI initiatives at its Build conference, emphasizing its competitive stance against OpenAI with a range of innovative tools.

AI.title: Google must let publishers opt out of AI Search features, rules UK
AI.summary: A UK regulatory ruling mandates Google to allow publishers to opt out of AI Search features, enhancing content control for website owners.

AI.title: Amazon’s search bar will invent AI-generated products you can’t buy
AI.summary: Amazon's search bar now generates AI-created product images based on user descriptions, enhancing the shopping experience with visual suggestions.

AI.title: Microsoft Build 2026: The 7 biggest announcements
AI.summary: Microsoft's Build 2026 showcased major announcements, including new hardware and updates across its AI models and personal assistant technologies.

AI.title: Google’s Phone app will tell you if a scammer is impersonating one of your contacts
AI.summary: Google's Phone app will now flag calls from scammers impersonating contacts, enhancing user protection against AI-driven impersonation scams.

NFL.title: Caleb Williams chosen for Madden 27 cover
NFL.summary: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams has been named the cover model for Madden NFL 27, highlighting his rising star status in the league.

NFL.title: Nolan Teasley will control the Vikings' 53-man roster and run football operations
NFL.summary: The Vikings have appointed Nolan Teasley as the new general manager responsible for controlling the team's 53-man roster and football operations.

NFL.title: Aaron Glenn: Congrats to Russell Wilson on TV job, we're looking at QB options
NFL.summary: Russell Wilson will join CBS as an analyst for The NFL Today, opting for broadcasting over a backup quarterback role with the Jets.

NFL.title: Dolphins sign 10 of their draft picks
NFL.summary: The Dolphins have signed 10 of their 2026 draft picks in a flurry of activity, catching up after a slow start to the signing process.

NFL.title: Joey Porter Jr. doing limited work at Steelers OTAs with contract extension looming
NFL.summary: Joey Porter Jr. is participating in limited work at Steelers OTAs as he seeks a contract extension amid team negotiations.

NFL.summary: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell is expected to decline an invitation to testify regarding the Sports Broadcasting Act, according to reports.
